title: opencode mesh: mesh.json
description: Marks a repo (or folder) as an opencode mesh and holds shared settings. All fields are optional.

$schema.description: This schema's URL; it carries the file-format version (v1).

pin.description: mesh version every device converges to (set by `mesh update`).

interval.description: How often devices pull: seconds, or a number with s, m or h (minimum 1m).
